records.semanticMeaning: India's national digital public infrastructure is supported as a functioning carrier for current payments and digital-service delivery.
records.exactMechanism: Interoperable payments, broadband-linked public access points and service centres carry transactions and public digital services through an operating national network.
records.whySupported: UPI transaction scale and participating-bank count, together with BharatNet service-ready Gram Panchayats and Common Service Centres, demonstrate active carrier function rather than policy intent alone.
records.competingInterpretation: Some of the observed scale could coexist with meaningful exclusion or regional quality gaps.
unresolvedEvidence: Distributional access quality and service reliability.

records.semanticMeaning: India's industrial/logistics subsystem is supported as an ongoing organized runtime operating through manufacturing output and commissioned freight infrastructure.
records.exactMechanism: Manufacturing establishments produce at current scale while commissioned cargo terminals and freight networks route goods and capacity through an active logistics system.
records.whySupported: Current IIP manufacturing growth is directly observed and the freight-terminal system is already commissioned with measurable handling capacity.
records.competingInterpretation: Recent industrial acceleration may be cyclical and some infrastructure additions are still under build-out.

records.semanticMeaning: Crude-import exposure and fuel-and-power price pressure are supported as active constraints on India's current industrial-economic runtime.
records.exactMechanism: Imported hydrocarbon requirements expose domestic production and consumption to external energy costs, while elevated fuel-and-power inflation transmits that exposure into current operating costs.
records.whySupported: Government energy-security material identifies a large crude import bill and explicit import-reduction objective, while August 2026 wholesale data shows direct fuel-and-power cost pressure.
records.competingInterpretation: Domestic energy substitution and differing sector fuel intensity can reduce or redistribute the aggregate constraint.
unresolvedEvidence: Duration of the current price shock and sector-specific pass-through.

blocked.reason: Projection-based demographic evidence does not by itself establish the direct continuity mechanism required for RP admission.

boundary: Only EVIDENCE_READY India semantic bases advance. Candidate generation is not position admission.
